_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0% base rate of ±2pt moves across 50 consecutive 12h windows makes HOLD the only statistically defensible call — a directional bet here requires seeing the coil breaker, and neither brain has confirmed it yet.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing a pinned coil under macro stress, while the narrative writer implies an imminent upward resolution to the accumulation divergence.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows revive above 30 AND funding drops below 40 with BTC momentum holding above 45
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX sustains above 75 for 24h with exchange netflow staying above 95 and BTC 30d momentum dropping below 35
